input.summary: Make the Deliverable licence perpetual and irrevocable, extend it to Affiliates and contractors, and allow transfer to a successor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a Deliverable licence that Vendor may revoke at will and that lapses at the end of the Order Form term, particularly for work product we paid to have created; this also conflicts with Sections 13.3 and 10.1. We have made the licence perpetual and irrevocable and extended it to our Affiliates and contractors, with transfer permitted to a successor under Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, display, modify, and create derivative works from each Deliverable for their business purposes, transferable to an Affiliate or successor in accordance with Section 13.3.
